choice_failed: aiodos-net companion: couldn't choose the program ({error}).
not_found: aiodos-net companion not found: it comes with updates, from a paired machine that has it (or build it: see compagnon/README.md).
too_old_for_tunnels: This machine's aiodos-net companion is too old: it would open the tunnel to the lent graphics card to every program on the machine. Update AIODOS on this machine.
tunnel_unguarded: On this system, the aiodos-net companion can't check which program connects to the tunnel to the lent graphics card: no model split across machines from this machine.
tunnel_not_kept: This machine's aiodos-net companion didn't guard the tunnel: update AIODOS on this machine.
